bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Euclidean distance between LLM-generated judgments on contract fairness, consent, and legal obligation against empirical survey baselines of ordinary lay individuals versus elite legal professionals.

Using Silicon Randomized Controlled Trials (S-RCTs) to test whether LLMs replicate counterintuitive human folk reasoning and heuristics, such as prioritizing social conformity over economic efficiency in negligence, or exhibiting lay contract formalism.

Analyzing systematic statistical distortions in LLM outputs, such as safety-alignment-induced consent compression and scale ceiling effects, by comparing model effect magnitudes directly to human behavioral baselines.
